correctness.rationale: Read RESULT.md and verifier source. For order-11 q, any ≤10-term vanishing sum corresponds to nonnegative degree≤10 polynomial g with total coefficient count ≤10. Since Φ11 irreducible, resultant R(Φ11,g) is nonzero integer |R|≤10^10 and p^k|R, reducing for k≥3 to p<2155, 29 primes ≡1 mod 11. Independently coded C++ sieve, Hensel root generator and complete stars-and-bars enumeration; scanned 31 full moduli ×352715 coefficient vectors=10,934,165, found only minimum 9 for p=23 at levels 3 and4, no ≤10 sum at 23^5 or all other p^3. Reduction from p^k to p^3/23^5 plus 11-term cyclotomic sum establishes every higher k, not extrapolation from finite range. The exact p23 sequence was prior; uniform all-prime assertion is assessed.
